summary: rollcall gc removes a worktree by moving it to a trash folder first, so a slow removal can no longer strand it half-deleted, logs what it keeps and why, and drops a chat's worktree once its work landed. rollcall clean now clears rebuildable files without asking and lists only old unlanded worktrees for a yes.
why: A 30-second limit killed big worktree removals partway, and gc then kept them forever as uncommitted changes.
